title: [挑戦しよう] すべての注文が2種類以上の商品を含む顧客
statement:
customers, orders, order_items から、すべての注文が2種類以上の商品を含んでいる顧客を表示してください。出力する列は customer_name です。

注文が1件もない顧客は対象外です。同じ商品が複数明細に分かれている場合でも、種類数は1として数えます。customer_name の昇順で並べます。

constraints.name: 注文単位の集計
constraints.value: 注文ごとに DISTINCT product_id の数を数えます

constraints.name: 全注文の条件
constraints.value: 2種類未満の商品しかない注文が1つでもある顧客は除外します

starterSql:
WITH order_product_counts AS (
  SELECT
    orders.id AS order_id,
    orders.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.product_id) AS product_count
  FROM orders
  JOIN order_items
    ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
  GROUP BY orders.id, orders.customer_id
)
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name
FROM customers
-- 条件を満たす顧客だけを残します
ORDER BY customers.name ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH order_product_counts AS (
  SELECT
    orders.id AS order_id,
    orders.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.product_id) AS product_count
  FROM orders
  JOIN order_items
    ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
  GROUP BY orders.id, orders.customer_id
)
SELECT
  customers.name AS customer_name
FROM customers
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM orders
  WHERE orders.customer_id = customers.id
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_product_counts
  WHERE order_product_counts.customer_id = customers.id
    AND order_product_counts.product_count < 2
)
ORDER BY customers.name ASC;

tests.name: 重複商品は1種類として数える
